issues.issue: Printed only as 'Tax revenue'. Property tax is likely (a property taxes receivable line is on p1, and hospital districts levy property tax), but the page doesn't say the tax type, so 'taxes (unlabeled)' would also be defensible.

issues.on_page: Accrued compensated absences and related benefits, excluding current portion 319,222
issues.issue: This is the long-term (noncurrent) portion. The rules limit 'accrued liabilities' to compensated absences due soon, so 'other liabilities' may fit better.

issues.on_page: Supplies and Other column (11,102,920 total, p9)
issues.issue: The Schedule 3 'Supplies and Other' column includes employee benefits and payroll taxes (1,823,916 on p3) and other objects, yet all of it is tagged supplies and materials. Benefits are understated and supplies overstated at the object level. The extractor's notes disclose this, but the object split is an approximation.
